description: The ready WakeHuBERT streaming 'alexa' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.45).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic TTS wake words (the shipped heads' positive sources, one voice in ten held out) in 30 s synthetic streams (LibriSpeech train-clean-100, KWS windows, AudioSet noise, RIR), streamed WakeHuBERT-tiny int8 features.
